title: goal: Governed factory M5: package freeze
body:
**Kind:** goal

Source: `docs/designs/governed-factory.md` (milestone m5).

## Job

When the factory works for its author, I want a published package, a conformance report, a case study, manuals and a recorded demo, so I can offer it to others.

## Outcome

- The conformance report lists only what passes: sources and execution providers as pluggable with two implementations each (with the shared provider contract suite), and one reference implementation for containment and for signing (M5-1).
- The case study reports measured numbers from the run records (M5-2), and the manuals exist (M5-3).
- The demo recording shows a passing verification and a rejected tampered bundle (M5-6).
- A third party runs the demo from a clean machine; `npm view agentflow-sdlc` shows `latest` with provenance, cut by the author (M5-4); the website passes `npm run validate` in the movetheneedle repository.

## Release intent

The npm `latest` release (the author's act) and the month-6 package.

## Split judgment

Each work item in this milestone of the design is one focused PR with a declared scope; items that require each other stay one PR. The milestone's re-verification item (where it has one) lands first and fixes the exact file list. Shipping order follows the design's table.
